|---|---|

| Severance costs | +74 |
| Legal settlements | 0 |
| Contract termination costs | +37 |
| Income tax effects and adjustments | (404) |
| **Non-GAAP net income (derived)** | **3,669** |

Notes on basis and comparability:
- All figures come from the same filing and cover the same 12-month period ended December 31, 2025 (ServiceNow's fiscal year equals the calendar year), so there is no fiscal-period or entity mismatch [servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt].
- The dominant adjustment is stock-based compensation ($1,955M), which alone exceeds GAAP net income — non-GAAP net income is more than 2x the GAAP figure, so the two measures are not interchangeable.
- For context, the same release shows GAAP income from operations of $1,824M with the same operating-level add-backs (SBC, intangibles amortization, business combination costs, impairment, severance, contract termination), implying non-GAAP income from operations of $4,149M [servicenow_8k_fy2025_opinc.txt]. The gap versus non-GAAP net income reflects below-the-line items and the $(404)M tax effect.
- Per-share (non-GAAP diluted EPS) was not included in the retrieved excerpt, so it cannot be cited here.

ANSWER: Approximately $3,669 million (~$3.67 billion) non-GAAP net income for FY2025, derived from GAAP net income of $1,748M plus the disclosed reconciling adjustments
